description: Play English draughts (checkers) with full rules — forced captures, multi-jumps and kinging — against a greedy AI or a friend.

faqs.a: Yes. If any of your pieces can capture, you must take a capture — the game only lets you pick capturing moves, and multi-jumps must be completed.
Any man that reaches the farthest row is crowned a king and can then move and capture diagonally in both directions.
faqs.q: How does a piece become a king?

faqs.a: The computer prefers the capture that takes the most pieces and otherwise moves randomly — it plays fast but makes mistakes you can exploit.
You win by capturing all enemy pieces, or when the opponent has no legal move left on their turn.

howto: Pick “Vs computer” or “Two players”, then press New game.
Click one of your pieces — legal destinations light up.
Captures are forced: when a jump is available you must take it, and keep jumping while you can.
Reach the far row to crown a king. First to capture everything wins.
title: Checkers
